entries.title: Hints show your keyboard preset's own keys
entries.body: On Vim, Emacs or VS Code keys, the labels beside buttons, command search, Keyboard settings and the main message now name the preset's own key, such as ⇧L for the next card on Vim, instead of the ⌘ key it keeps from the earlier keys. The ⌘ keys still work as before.

picture.alt: A card's foot on Vim keys: the reply field shows R, and the Next card label under the pager shows ⇧L
